latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 4to1-planner — AI planning coach using the 4To1 Method™.

- Guides users to turn 4-year visions into daily actions with conversation, not templates.
- Supports integration with Notion, Todoist, Google Calendar, or local Markdown files for storing plans.
- Provides step-by-step setup instructions for each backend, including database/project structure creation.
- Activates when the user wants to plan goals, do weekly reviews, track projects, or setup a planning system.
- Includes conversational onboarding to define vision, milestones, sprints, and daily actions.
